item.text: I’ll make the unified field narrowly for rule segments as requested, keeping rollout’s existing segment schema intact. Structured rule segments will require nonempty keys and a recognized operator; one-key objects normalize to the singular key with OR. The YAML decoder will reject nulls, scalars of other types, and malformed mappings.

package ext

	flags   []*flipt.Flag
	flagErr error

	segments   []*flipt.Segment
	segmentErr error

	rules   []*flipt.Rule
	ruleErr error

	rollouts   []*flipt.Rollout
	rolloutErr error
}

func (m mockLister) ListFlags(_ context.Context, _ *flipt.ListFlagRequest) (*flipt.FlagList, error) {
	return &flipt.FlagList{
		Flags: m.flags,
	}, m.flagErr
}

func (m mockLister) ListRules(_ context.Context, r *flipt.ListRuleRequest) (*flipt.RuleList, error) {
	if r.FlagKey == "flag1" {
		return &flipt.RuleList{
			Rules: m.rules,
		}, m.ruleErr
	}

	return &flipt.RuleList{}, m.ruleErr
}

func (m mockLister) ListSegments(_ context.Context, _ *flipt.ListSegmentRequest) (*flipt.SegmentList, error) {
	return &flipt.SegmentList{
		Segments: m.segments,
	}, m.segmentErr
}

}

						Id:        "1",
						VariantId: "1",

		rollouts: []*flipt.Rollout{
			{
				Id:          "1",

				Description: "enabled for internal users",
				Rank:        int32(1),
				Rule: &flipt.Rollout_Segment{
					Segment: &flipt.RolloutSegment{
						SegmentKey: "internal_users",
						Value:      true,

				Id:          "2",

	assert.NoError(t, err)

item.text: A test exposed an important serialization detail: because the wrapper embeds an interface as a field, YAML v2 needs the custom marshaler to return the underlying `Segments` value (not a wrapped struct, now corrected). The export fixture’s mock currently supplies only one segment; I’ll update it to include segment2 and make the exporter test verify canonical object output, as required.
